changelog:
soul-agent 1.0.1 introduces a heartbeat engine, mood system, relationship mechanics, daily planning, and enhanced memory for a more lifelike digital companion.

- Added heartbeat, mood, relationship, and daily plan systems to make the agent "live beside you"
- New scripts: heartbeat management, daily planning (plan_generator.py), LLM-powered narrative (heartbeat_engine.py), memory distillation (distill_life_log.py)
- Integrated mood transitions, 5-stage relationship tracking, and auto-updating energy/state
- 5 built-in life profiles with configurable schedules (freelancer, corporate, student, entrepreneur, custom)
- Agent-driven initialization with user-friendly questions and non-interactive setup
- Runtime writes detailed logs, plans, and mood history into the workspace for independent memory
- All features designed for easy scheduling (e.g., via cron) and safe, managed file updates
